Background Remover · free, in your browser

Make a transparent PNG from any picture

Drop a photo, a logo or a scanned signature and download it as a PNG with a transparent background, ready for slides, documents, stickers or a website.

Make a transparent PNG

How to do it

  1. Drop or paste the picture (Ctrl+V works too).
  2. The AI cuts out the subject and the background becomes transparent.
  3. Refine the edge with Threshold, Softness and Feather, or brush in what was missed.
  4. Download the PNG. The transparent parts stay transparent wherever you place it.

Your files stay on this device: Background Remover runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Will the PNG really be transparent?

Yes. Everything outside the subject is saved with zero opacity, so it shows whatever is behind it in the next app.

Does it work for logos and signatures?

Yes. Logos and dark ink on paper cut out well; use the Quality model for fine strokes and check the edges at full size.

Is there a watermark or a size limit?

No watermark, and the PNG is saved at the size of your original picture.

Can I make a WebP instead?

Yes. WebP also keeps transparency and is smaller; choose it in the export settings.
